label: Finding-40
title: preannounce-time: The Foundation's post gives two times for the pre-announcement
description: php-foundation-blog-security-release says 'published it at 19:30 UTC' and two paragraphs later 'the leak and pre-announcement around 20:00 UTC'. The note cites only the feed (20:32Z) and oss-security (20:22:51Z) against it; the source's own inconsistency should be shown.
